description: $0.002 per call (x402, USDC on Base; free trial: add "trial": true or use try_free). [Data utilities] Reads a 5-field cron expression (or @daily-style macro) and returns the next N run times in UTC and in the given time zone, a plain-English description and the expanded fields. Input: cron, optional tz (default UTC), count 1-20, after. Limits: no seconds field, no L/W/#. Offline.

after.description: Start after this time (ISO 8601 or Unix seconds; default now)

cron.description: 5-field cron expression (minute hour day-of-month month day-of-week), or @hourly, @daily, @weekly, @monthly, @yearly

trial.description: Optional. true = free if a trial call is left (3 per IP per UTC day), else the payment terms.

tz.description: IANA time zone the schedule runs in (default UTC)

name: cron_next

_trial.description: Present when the call was a free trial call.

title: Cron next run times + plain-English description ($0.002/call)
